resources.string: Shows whether M’AND is connected to your Mac.
Touch your phone to your MacBook to send what’s on your screen. M’AND only looks at the screen during a tap and never reads what’s inside your apps. It stays off in the banking apps you pick.
Your Mac is looking for this phone
Tap here or press Stop to end the sound.
Showing your screen on your Mac
Only your Mac can see it. Tap Stop to end.
Your Mac wants to see your screen
Tap here, then “Start now”. You can stop at any time.
